_comment: Copy this to config.json and edit for your workspace. Every field is optional — delete what you don't need. claudeDir defaults to <home>/.claude; repos auto-detect from active Claude sessions; colors are derived from names when unset.
_opencode: Where OpenCode keeps its data, and the headless server the Joeru chat talks to. Leave null unless yours are elsewhere. Port 4097 rather than OpenCode's default 4096, which collides with the Kilo Code VS Code extension.
_joeruKit: Path to a joeru-kit checkout — the Memory tab reads and writes the markdown there. Defaults to a sibling directory of this repo. Leave null if you don't use it; the Memory tab then says so instead of failing.
_tasksFile: The task board your agents write. This is Synapse's own format, not Claude Code's — Claude has no native task board. Defaults to <repo>/data/tasks.json, gitignored, alongside the SQLite database. Point it elsewhere if you like, but tell your agents the new path too, or they will keep writing the old one and the board will silently freeze.
_projects: OPTIONAL. Groups repos in the Agent Network so no single project looks like the root. Leave this out entirely and projects are derived from each repo's parent folder, which is usually right — C:/work/acme/api and C:/work/acme/web become one 'acme' project. Declare it only to rename, reorder, add emoji, or group repos that do not share a folder. Repos you name in no project fall to the first one rather than vanishing.
